title: Dragon Ball Super Needs to Figure Out What’s Next for Broly
content:
The reintroduction to Broly brought up a lot of possibilities when it comes to his future in the Dragon Ball universe, but all of that is still unknown. The Legendary Super Saiyan appeared in Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero , but in a cameo role. His small storyline focused on controlling his insane powers. Broly appeared to learn a lot while watching an educational fight between Vegeta and Goku. The two Saiyans were showing him how to fight without destroying the environment around him. He genuinely seemed interested in how to control his powers, but beyond that, he sat on the sidelines.

His story stops there for the time being, however. New Broly didn’t get a fight in Super Dragon Ball Heroes even if his non-canon counterpart did. The evil Broly from Dragon Ball Z resurfaced for the first time since his movie trilogy igniting rumors about a multiverse clash. Furthermore, the introduction of Cumber could add another monster Saiyan matchup to the future. Nothing is confirmed yet, but there are a lot of directions this could go and Dragon Ball really needs to figure it out.

Broly Set To Join The Z Fighters

The Z Fighters are known for bringing former opponents into their group. Tien, Chiaotzu, Piccolo, Vegeta and Androids 17 and 18 were all added after initially fighting against Goku and his friends. Broly looks like he could follow the same path into the squad . The main focus for Broly right now is helping train and power up Vegeta and Goku, but why would they not include him in ensuing fights? He’s clearly got the highest power ceiling of any of the fighters and can adapt quicker than any fighter. His problem is simply harnessing his abilities.

Plot wise it doesn’t make much sense for one of the series’ most powerful characters to stay on the bench for too long. Not to mention, Broly is a fan favorite. The next anime entry could time skip a bit to turn him into a more finished product. It also makes sense that Broly takes the next step in his leveling because the future enemies in the series should get stronger . The franchise is always topping prior power levels to make the stakes higher, so Broly will definitely get a fight in the near future.

His future story contains a lot of what-ifs that can be explored too. His short screen time in the movie only addressed his past briefly, which was all but spent on Vampa. However, it didn’t give enough insight into his full relationship with his father. It seemed like a complex situation, especially when most of what Paragus did to him was abusive. Broly clearly cared when Paragus died, but was that a result of him being the only person in his life? Or was there a genuine father-son relationship at one point?

What Transformation Comes Next?

Regardless of canon or non-canon, the creative team behind Dragon Ball anime isn’t afraid to take an idea that works and move it into the official timeline. Since the concept of Broly was introduced more than 30 years ago, he appeared as the Legendary Super Saiyan. Broly received the same treatment in Dragon Ball Super . Then, Super Dragon Ball Heroes dropped and evil Broly decided to ascend to Super Saiyan 3 and 4.

These power-ups might seem less than considering the level that Goku and Vegeta achieved now, but as everyone learned in the Broly movie, his first Super Saiyan form proved a challenge even for Super Saiyan Blue Gogeta. In what power tier could Super Saiyan 2, 3 and 4 be for Broly? Again, the potential is there for a lot of expansion. He is a moldable character due to him being stranded out of society for a long time.

The initial components of a good person and character are there. Broly is a Saiyan that shouldn’t even be alive, if King Vegeta had his way. He was spared and eventually persevered through a brutal upbringing to find a good example in Goku and Vegeta. Here’s to hoping Broly stays the course and continues to progress. Would you like to see more of Broly in Dragon Ball’ s anime future? Let us know in the comments.

title: Giant Ojosama TV Anime Reveals More Cast
content:
The official X/Twitter account for the television anime of Nikumura Q 's Giant Ojō-sama (Giant Young Lady) manga revealed on Friday that Rina Kawaguchi will play Stella, another giant girl. The account streamed a character trailer:

The account revealed last week that Risa Imayanagi will play Madoka Ito, a member of the "Secret Service," who also becomes a giant girl.

The anime stars:

• Yū Serizawa as Oriko Fujido

• Junya Enoki as Dr. Sebastian

Hiroshi Ikehata ( WITCH WATCH ) is directing the anime at Tatsunoko Production . Katsuya Oshima is serving as assistant director. Hajime Mitsuda ( Food for the Soul ) is the character designer and chief animation director. Yū Satō ( Azur Lane: Slow Ahead! ) is handling the series composition and script. Yūsuke Shirato ( Rumble Garanndoll ), Kijibato , and Aira ( Dream Monster ) are composing the music.

The additional staff includes:

• Art Design: Takashi Hiruma

• Art Director: Akira Itō (StudioARA)

• Color Setting: Misako Akama

• Photography: Masashi Kamiki (Studio Myu), Yōhei Konishi (Studio Twinkle)

• Editing: Akinori Mishima

• Animation Producer: Miki Kaneko

The story centers around Oriko Fujidō, the scion of an ultra-wealthy family who finds herself growing to gigantic proportions. She had received an entire town as a present on her fourth birthday, but one day, a giant invader attacks her town. Her butler Sebastian offers her a drink that transforms her into a giant, so she strives to protect her town — but just might end up destroying it, throwing the denizens' lives into chaos.

Nikumura Q has been serializing the Giant Ojō-sama manga since July 2020 on Shogakukan 's Sunday Webry service. Shogakukan published the manga's 13th compiled book volume on September 11. The manga was nominated by for best web manga in the eighth "Next Manga Awards" (Tsugi ni Kuru Manga Taishō) in 2022, and it ranked #5 in AnimeJapan's sixth "Most Wanted Anime Adaptation" poll the following year.

title: J-Novel Club Licenses Putting a Price on World Peace Novels, I'm Dating a Dark Summoner Manga, More Titles
content:
J-Novel Club announced on Friday it has added seven new light novel series and six new manga series to its digital lineup.

In addition, the company announced it will release Nahuse 's Rebuild World light novel series in print starting on April 27, 2027, and Micoto Sakurai and Levin Aoi 's A Royal Rebound: Forget My Ex-Fiancé, I'm Being Pampered by the Prince! manga in print starting on June 8, 2027.

The new light novel licenses include:

Life is stressful enough as it is, so she doesn't need a video game that stresses her out too. Determined to take things at her own pace, Kokoro immediately sets out to find the perfect way to chill. And what better way than to befriend a new cute, cuddly companion? Naturally, that means she'll need a Slime as her first partner.

Forget dangerous battles and daring adventures. For now, Kokoro and her Slime are here to use their time to the fullest—and it all begins with crafting potions!

For Shionne, life as a Soldier Maid is a never-ending cycle of dangerous missions and barely adequate hazard pay. But everything changes when her bosses at the White Sisterhood pair her up with Iris Whitespuria—a shy, eyepatched rookie with a mysterious past. Shionne isn't quite sure what to make of her new partner, and the more time they spend together, the more questions arise.

Who is Iris, really? Why were they paired together? What is she hiding? More importantly, what is the White Sisterhood hiding? Oh, and while she's at it, how can someone this annoying be this cute?!

Shionne is quickly realizing that she's out of her depths in more ways than one. There's only one thing she knows for sure: whatever's going on here is definitely above her pay grade.

There's just one problem: I'm only free on weekends. That leaves me with Saturdays and Sundays to explore this new world, consume its culinary delights, and put my magic to use. Who knows? Maybe I'll even find a girlfriend!

It's exactly what I need to recharge after clocking out for the week... Guess I'm working for a weekend getaway to another world!

In a world fraught with frequent attacks by void beasts, magical girls protect mankind. But because they must draw their power from the support of livestream viewers, these adolescent girls risk their lives in battle knowing that a lapse in judgment—or simply fading from the spotlight—could spell their demise. Society may have accepted this reality, but one man, Shiraha Takatsuka, won't tolerate such heavy responsibilities being forced onto their tiny shoulders! Enter the world's first fully grown man turned magical girl! Now a protector of other magical girls, Shiraha is ready to show the world what happens when a reliable grown-up joins the team to save the world!

Takeshi Sato is struggling to keep his supernatural detective agency afloat when inspiration strikes. VTubers rake in a ton of cash, right? So why not become one himself? With little more than superficial knowledge of the industry and his trusty ghost partner at his side, Takeshi makes his debut as Midnight Psychoknight under a famous VTuber agency.

Naturally, one disastrous debut stream later, and he's cemented as chat's favorite punching bag. But just when he thinks his new career is doomed, his fellow VTubers and real-life friends begin rallying around him. Before he knows it, he's finding his footing and his subscriber count is climbing!

And so the curtains rise on this supernatural comedy filled with wacky hijinks, ghostly mysteries, and one struggling detective's quest for viral stardom!

Trao may be a member of the S-rank adventurer party Blue Ring, but as a merchant, he doesn't have much to offer when it comes to combat. So when his comrades learn he's been dipping into the party's funds, they kick him out without a second thought. With nowhere else to go, Trao decides to follow the money—more specifically, the funds he's been redirecting to the all-female party Garnet.

His goal? To take down the Demon King! But this journey is off to a less-than-heroic start, as his new comrades' first order of business is looting the corpses of Trao's former party. With the Demon King's invasion threatening to engulf the world, this pragmatic merchant might just be the unlikely answer to humanity's prayers. After all, saving the world is just another business opportunity!

The new manga licenses include:

Itoko Tachibana is an inquisitive young lady who has already been rejected by two potential suitors for being decidedly unladylike. Now facing a third matchmaking meeting, she has little hope of finding a suitable match—let alone love. But her latest prospect, Shun Otori, is quite unlike any man she has encountered before.

A man shrouded in intrigue, Shun has his own reasons for seeking a bride, and his desire for marriage comes with some surprising strings attached. What's more, rumors are circulating that he's broken from his usual patterns to make a connection with Itoko. With society watching their every move and secrets lurking beneath the surface, Itoko must decide whether she will let others dictate her life or dare to let her budding feelings for Shun bloom.

Then disaster strikes when Kai is expelled from his party just as Nagi's condition suddenly worsens. Unless he can pay the enormous hospital fee that is quickly coming due, he may lose his sister forever.

Driven to desperation, Kai takes a gamble on an expedition into an unexplored Cube, risking everything for a reward that could change his fate. Can Kai arise from zero to hero and save his beloved sister? The answer may be right before his eyes...

But when Kazuno's house—and all of his classmates—are suddenly transported to a world of high fantasy, his quiet life is turned upside down. Determined to save those closest to him, Kazuno ventures forth and faces life in the wild... with all the comforts and conveniences of modern living, right at home. Turns out his house might just be the gift that keeps on giving!

Her former comrade, Wayne, urges her to dream of a different future, but Lacey has long since resigned herself to her fate. She's even prepared to burn her beloved staff to appease the man she's supposed to marry. Then one day, she and Wayne stumble upon her husband-to-be cheating on her with multiple women, including the princess!

As the scandal comes to light before the king, Lacey finds herself at a crossroads. After a lifetime of having her choices made for her, she finally takes the first step toward the one thing she's never had: the freedom to live for herself.

This unlikely couple—or not, as one of them would insist—must learn to work together professionally and personally. From tackling problems in the bedroom to exploring dungeons, catching notorious thieves, and fighting powerful monsters, these two are in for all sorts of adventures!

title: Titan Holds Distribution of Five Star Stories Manga's 1st English Volume to Review Translation Situation
content:
ANN reached out to Titan Manga . A spokesperson from Titan Manga provided the following comment:

"We take the quality and integrity of our translations extremely seriously and fully recognize the gravity of this situation. As a precaution, we have placed a hold on distribution while we review the situation and determine the appropriate next steps. We remain committed to delivering an English edition that respects the original work and meets the standards fans deserve."

The company did not specify what the translation situation was in its comments. The first English volume credits Greco D. Espinoza as the translator.

In addition to a previous unfinished English release, the manga also had an controversial unofficial English translation.

Titan Manga and Newtype are planning to release the first English volume on December 1, following several delays. The companies were originally going to release the first volume on July 7, but delayed it to September 1, and then again to November 17.

Titan Manga describes the first volume:

Set in the vast and tumultuous Joker Star Cluster, this series brings together ancient empires, genetic engineering, and towering mechs known as Mortar Headds—piloted by elite warriors and their genetically engineered companions, the Fatimas. In Vol. 1, we meet Amaterasu, the immortal emperor of the Grees Kingdom, and his destined bride, Lachesis, as they navigate a world of intrigue, warfare, and forbidden power. As interstellar conflict rages, the stage is set for a war that could determine the fate of the galaxy.

Nagano launched his science fantasy manga series in Kadokawa 's Newtype magazine in 1986, although the series has been running intermittently since then. To mark the 25th anniversary of the manga in 2011, Kadokawa reissued the existing manga volumes in a "Repeat" edition with previously unpublished art.

The manga went on hiatus in 2006 and relaunched in the magazine's May 2013 issue. It went back on hiatus in spring 2014 as Nagano prepared the 13th compiled book volume for print. The manga resumed from its hiatus in February 2016. The 13th volume shipped in August 2016 after several delays. The 12th volume had shipped in 2006.

Kadokawa released the 19th and most recent compiled book volume on May 9.

Nagano's own Toyspress, Inc. published most of the manga in English. ADV Films released the 1989 anime film adaptation in North America.
author: ANN

title: Living It Up in Another World Until I Get Bored Novels Get TV Anime
content:
Hanashi Media licensed the light novels, and it describes the story:

As if the universe heard him, his journey begins sooner than expected. On his way home, he suddenly finds himself stranded in another world-a strange, game-like place governed by levels, magic, skills, and other fantastical rules. And before he knows it, he's acquired tremendous power without even having to work for it. With that kind of strength at his disposal, three paths lie before him: side with humanity and become a hero, join the demons and unleash chaos upon the world... or choose neither and use his newfound power for nothing more than his own amusement. For him, the choice is obvious. And so begins one thirty-something nobody's journey through another world, living exactly as he pleases until he gets bored!

Sanmongarasu debuted the web novel on Shōsetsuka ni Narō in June 2016. The first light novel volume with illustrations by Tomozo shipped in Japan in April 2019, and the eighth volume will ship on November 30. SAA debuted a manga adaptation in Shufunotomo 's Hero Comic in July 2025. Shufunotomo published the manga's first compiled book volume on September 30.

title: Gifted Baseball Webtoon Gets Live-Action TV Series Adaptation Premiering on December 5
content:
Kakao Entertainment announced on Friday a live-action television adaptation of Jung1212's baseball webtoon Gifted will premiere on tvN on December 5 at 9:10 p.m. KST.

The webtoon follows Min-yong Jeong, a baseball coach who gains the ability to see players' natural talents and limits to their potential after an accident. He takes over a high school baseball team ranked last nationwide and attempts to recruit Tae-hoon Cha, a player with exceptional natural talent. However, this threatens the position of Seung-il Heo, a pitcher who has worked hard to earn recognition through his efforts.

The story explores the tension between natural talent and hard work, following the players as they confront their own limitations and compete for opportunities. It also depicts the coach and the parents who support their children through the pressures of competitive sports.

Woo-bin Kim stars as Min-yong Jeong, while Eun-soo Seo plays Seo-jin Yoon, a physical education teacher who works to protect the baseball team. Chabin and Si-hyun Han portray Seung-il Heo and Tae-hoon Cha, respectively.

The original webtoon by Jung1212 has been serialized on Kakao Page since 2021.

Jung1212 said the opportunity to adapt the webtoon into a television drama was an unexpected gift. The artist also explained that the story reflects personal doubts about their own talent and creative abilities, adding that viewers may find more meaning in the characters' struggles when considering the questions of talent, effort, and accepting the results of one's work.

Fans can read the official English version of the webtoon on Tapas .

title: Aquaman Romance Webtoon Gets Japanese Live-Action Series Premiering on December 25
content:
Kakao Entertainment announced on Thursday McQueen Studio's romance webtoon Aquaman is being adapted into a Japanese live-action series by Fuji TV . The 10-episode series will premiere simultaneously in Japan and South Korea on December 25 through Fuji TV 's streaming service and Wavve , a Korean streaming platform, respectively.

The original webtoon ran from 2016 to 2019 and recorded approximately 200 million cumulative views on Kakao Page . It follows longtime friends whose relationship becomes complicated as the boundaries between friendship and romance blur.

The now-defunct service Spottoon had previously released the series in English and describes the story:

Jump into the life of twenty-something Naru as he navigates through the confusing world of modern dating. He's faced with familiar moments we've all been through such as “should I add that smiley face at the end of the text?” or “why haven't they responded to my text?” But the added challenge for Naru? He's never dated, doesn't use a cellphone and most importantly someone's out there to sabotage his dating life!

The series is a joint adaptation project between Kakao Entertainment and Fuji TV . Kakao Entertainment provided the original intellectual property and participated in the planning and development, while Fuji TV is handling the Japanese production in collaboration with production company AOI Pro.

Haru Kashiwagi stars as Naru Shintani, based on the original character Naru Shin. Noritaka Hamao plays Kazunari Ikeda, adapted from Sung-joon Choi, while Karen Ōtomo portrays Sora Hoshino, based on Sora Choi.

Junichi Kanai is directing the series, with Erika Seki writing the screenplay. New episodes will premiere every Friday following the December 25 debut.

Currently, an official English version of the webtoon is not available.

A North American release of the live-action series is not yet confirmed.

title: Purge List Webtoon's Live-Action Film Adaptation Begins Production for 2027 Release
content:
The live-action film adaptation of the webtoon Purge List has begun production, with actors Woo-sung Jung , Sung-il Jung, and Ha-joon Wi among its cast members. According to Korean news outlet YTN on November 5, the film is scheduled to premiere in theaters in 2027.

The historical action film centers on Joseon-era political figure Myeong-hoe Han ( Woo-sung Jung ), a ruthless power broker, and the people whose lives become entangled with his political purges. Sung-il Jung plays Banseok, the leader of a secret organization opposing Han, while Ha-joon Wi portrays Prince Suyang, who seeks to claim the throne.

The supporting cast includes Chang-seok Go as general Jong-seo Kim. Ji-hwan Park, Daniel Choi, and Sung-wook Lee will play members of the Six Martyred Ministers. Other supporting cast members include Gwi-hwa Choi, Bok-rae Jo, Bong-sik Hyun, Yoon-sik Baek, and Moo-sung Choi.

The original webtoon by Jong-hoon Kim gained attention after winning the grand prize at the inaugural Daum Online Comics Contest. The webtoon has recorded 120 million cumulative views on Kakao Webtoon, where it had been serialized between 2014 and 2015.

Currently, an official English version of the webtoon is not available.

title: Stage Musical Adaptation of Webtoon The Siren: Becoming the Villain's Family to Premiere in Seoul on March 24, 2027
content:
Korean musical production company ShowNote announced on October 28 that its upcoming stage musical The Siren will run from March 24 to June 13, 2027, at the Charlotte Theater in Seoul.

The musical is based on Sol Leesu's popular romance-fantasy web novel Siren: I Became a Contract Family with the Villain . Poya also adapted the novel into the webtoon The Siren: Becoming the Villain's Family , which has garnered over 220 million views on Kakao Page and Kakao Webtoon services.

The story follows Lloyd, the grand duke of the Valentine family, which has been afflicted by a demonic curse for generations. Aria, a siren whose voice can move people's hearts, holds the key to lifting his curse.

The English version of the The Siren: Becoming the Villain's Family webtoon is available on Tapas . The original web novel does not have an official English release.

title: Omniscient Reader, Greatest Estate Developer, Debut or Die!, 7 More Works Win 2026 World Webtoon Awards
content:
South Korea's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism (MCST) and the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA) announced on November 3 the 10 main award winners of the 2026 World Webtoon Awards, including Omniscient Reader .

The winners are:

• Return of the Blossoming Blade

• Cry, or Better Yet, Beg

• Omniscient Reader

• My S-Class Hunters

• Jakdu: Shaman's Blade

• Debut or Die!

• On the Way to Meet Mom

• The Greatest Estate Developer

• Killer Peter

• A Man's Man

The awards had announced the 20 finalists in September. This year's awards received 7,318 nominations from 4,038 fans worldwide, with 941 works submitted in total.

Now in its third year, the World Webtoon Awards recognizes outstanding webtoons from around the world, without restrictions on creators' nationalities or the regions where their works are serialized. Each of the 10 winners will receive a trophy and 10 million won (about US$7,200).

The awards ceremony will take place on December 3 at Starfield Library in COEX Mall, Seoul. The grand prize and Judges' Award winners will be selected from the 10 main award recipients at the ceremony. The grand prize winner will receive an additional 5 million won (about US$3,600), while the Judges' Award winner will receive an additional 3 million won (about US$2,200).

The World Webtoon Festival will also run from December 2 to 6 at COEX Hall B and the surrounding Starfield COEX Mall area. The festival will feature special exhibitions showcasing domestic and international webtoons and intellectual property, as well as events and activities for creators and fans.
